verses.text: Whoever lives in the shelter of the Most High will find rest in the Almighty’s shadow.
I’ll say of the LORD, “He’s my refuge and my fortress. He’s my God, and I trust him.”
He’ll pull you out of the bird catcher’s trap and save you from deadly disease.
He’ll cover you with his feathers, and you’ll find shelter under his wings. His faithfulness is your shield and your defense.
You won’t fear what comes at you in the night or the arrow that flies in broad daylight,
the disease that moves through the dark or the destruction that strikes at noon.
A thousand may fall beside you, ten thousand at your right hand, but it won’t come near you.
You’ll see it with your own eyes when the wicked get what they’ve earned.
You’ve made the LORD your refuge and the Most High your home.
No harm will come to you, and no plague will come near where you live.
He’ll give his angels orders to guard you wherever you go.
They’ll lift you up in their hands so you don’t strike your foot against a stone.
You’ll step on the lion and the cobra. You’ll trample the young lion and the snake underfoot.
“Because he loves me, I’ll rescue him. I’ll lift him out of danger because he knows my name.
He’ll call to me and I’ll answer. I’ll be right there with him in trouble. I’ll rescue him and honor him.
I’ll give him a long life to satisfy him, and I’ll show him how I save.”
